algorithm: k(r) = sha256(seed + ':' + lineHash(r)); records ordered ascending by (k, lineHash); qualification = last 80 of the ordering; dev = last 80 of the remainder; train = the rest
lineHashAlgorithm: sha256(utf-8(raw line bytes, trailing CR stripped))

lineageDisclosure.whatThisDoesNotSupport: A claim of an independent second benchmark corpus, or any use of the consumed Gold v0.1 TEST split as promotion evidence.
lineageDisclosure.whatThisSupports: A held-out qualification measurement over the EXP-002 development distribution, fixed before training and never inspected.
lineageDisclosure.whyNoNewCorpus: The repository has no committed deterministic generator mapping raw UCL source records to gold examples; the 800 governed examples were sampled during the M3A session. A genuinely new gold cohort therefore requires a new governed annotation process and cannot be produced by re-running code.

qualificationPolicy: qualification.jsonl is written once, hashed, and MUST NOT be read, tokenized, parsed or inspected until the V1 promotion gate. Only its hash may travel.

source.note: TEST was consumed by Evaluation Attempt #6 (DEC-0048) and is never a source here.
